Input: {"post_id":"2100312094910661095","context":{"post":"Sources / primary evidence:

ZTE — Nubia NaviX Ultra commercial launch, Doubao Mobile Assistant + Seed full-duplex voice model:
https://t.co/cx9Byjj8oM

Salesforce — AIforce, enterprise context / permissions / MCP / skills / Zero Data Retention:
https://t.co/iwDgitdi3u","local_parent":"🚨 THE AGENT WAR JUST MOVED BELOW THE APP LAYER.

Two launches in one day make the direction painfully clear:

ByteDance is putting an Agent into the operating fabric of the phone.

Salesforce is building the control plane that lets Agents operate inside the enterprise.

The model is becoming the reasoning engine.

The real war is moving to:

CONTEXT.
PERMISSIONS.
MEMORY.
ACTIONS.
AUDIT.
DISTRIBUTION.

First, the phone.

ZTE just commercially launched the Nubia NaviX Ultra with the consumer version of Doubao Mobile Assistant and ByteDance Seed’s latest full-duplex voice model.

This is not just “AI inside a phone.”

The Agent can work across apps, send Feishu messages, schedule meetings, summarize group chats, forward documents, use maps, mobility and music services, keep tasks running while the phone is locked, and, according to ZTE, decompose and execute workflows lasting hundreds of steps and tens of minutes.

Voice is becoming interruptible and continuous.

Vision is entering the loop.

Memory is persistent with user permission.

Execution crosses app boundaries.

The Agent is moving from something you OPEN to something the operating environment can CALL.

Now look at what Salesforce launched on the exact same day.

AIforce.

Salesforce is exposing its data, workflows, business logic, semantics, permissions, security and governance to external AI interfaces through MCP, APIs, plugins and skills.

Claude gets a prebuilt Salesforce MCP server plus 37 sales skills.

Claude Code gets 40+ development skills.

Existing Salesforce permissions remain in force.

Actions route back through Salesforce.

Model providers are required to operate with Zero Data Retention.

And Salesforce is explicitly designing this beyond Claude, across Anthropic, AWS, Google, OpenAI and others.

That architecture matters.

MODEL
↓
reasoning

HARNESS / CONTROL PLANE
↓
context + permissions + state + audit + execution

MCP / APIs
↓
real systems

This is starting to look less like “AI software” and more like an operating architecture for Agents.

On consumer hardware, ByteDance wants the Agent underneath the app experience.

In enterprise software, Salesforce wants the execution boundary underneath the Agent.

Different markets.

Same direction.

The durable advantage may not belong to whoever owns the smartest model.

It may belong to whoever owns the layer that decides:

WHAT the model can see.
WHAT it can touch.
WHAT it can change.
HOW long it can act.
AND whether humans can inspect, stop, or recover from it.

The Agent era is turning into a control-plane war."}}
